answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The terrace holds work receipts rather than names, so the orchard of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The tundra of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
